'''''Kniphofia'' × ''praecox''''', also known as '''''Kniphofia praecox''''' or the '''greater red-hot poker'''<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2022-04-14 |title=''Kniphofia'' × ''praecox'' |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/9759/greater-red-hot-poker/details |access-date=2022-04-14 |website=www.rhs.org.uk}}</ref> is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (botany)|family]] [[Asphodelaceae]].

This species is believed to be the result of [[Hybrid (biology)|hybridization]] between ''[[Kniphofia uvaria]]'' and ''Kniphofia bruceae'', leading to it being referred to as ''Kniphofia'' × ''praecox''.<ref name=":3" />

== Description ==
''Kniphofia'' × ''praecox'' is a clump forming [[Perennial plant|perennial]] species, with narrow grass-like leaves. Leaves can reach a maximum length of 2 metres. Plants produce upright, long flower stalks.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2018-04-21 |title=''Kniphofia praecox'' |url=https://www.pacificbulbsociety.org/pbswiki/index.php/Kniphofia_praecox |access-date=2022-04-14 |website=www.pacificbulbsociety.org}}</ref> Due to the plants flower stalks they can reach a height of 1.5 metres tall.<ref name=":2">{{Cite book |last=De Moor, Lubke |first=Irene J., Roy |title=Field Guide to the Eastern & Southern Cape Coasts |publisher=University of Cape Town Press |year=1998 |isbn=9781919713038 |location=Cape Town |pages=246}}</ref> Stems host a cylindrical cluster of flowers.<ref name=":1" /> Flower buds start off scarlet red and transition to a reddish-orange and then yellow as they mature.<ref name=":2" /> 

== Distribution ==
''Kniphofia'' × ''praecox'' is [[Native species|native]] to [[South Africa]], where it is found from the [[Swartberg]] Mountains to the [[Eastern Cape]].<ref name=":1" />

The species is used in gardens around the world as an [[ornamental plant]].<ref name=":0" /> Introduced/escaped populations have been recorded within the [[United Kingdom]], [[Belgium]], [[New Zealand]], [[Colombia]] and [[Ecuador]].<ref>{{GBIF |id=5305162 |taxon=''Kniphofia'' × ''praecox'' |accessdate=14 April 2022}}</ref>

== Habitat ==
''Kniphofia'' × ''praecox'' naturally grows alongside streams, riverbanks and [[Marsh|marshland]] habitats.<ref name=":2" />

It is naturally found at elevations of around 2400 metres above sea level.<ref name=":3">{{cite POWO |id=537075-1 |title=''Kniphofia'' × ''praecox'' |accessdate=14 April 2022}}</ref>

Outside of its natural range it has been recorded to grow on the verges of railway tracks.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-04-14 |title=''Kniphofia'' × ''praecox'' |url=https://alienplantsbelgium.myspecies.info/content/kniphofia-x-praecox |access-date=2022-04-14 |website=alienplantsbelgium.myspecies.info}}</ref>
